scope: Discovery-only cost partition of standalone generated public Boolean solves; no constructor optimization, holdouts, curve inputs, keys, production or rho campaign.
ordering: Four deterministic Fisher-Yates permutations per fixture, each followed by its exact reverse; use the retained SplitMix64 order implementation.
phase_contract: encoding_ns compiles the complete syndrome; construction_ns builds the schedule; scan_ns calls the shared non-inlined hot kernel; release_ns covers destruction. Profile and rebound use identical builders and scan functions. Fresh contexts and validation are charged in total_ns; fixtures, status-reference preparation, original-policy validation solves and clock calibration are in process receipts only.
bound: For a fixed unchanged scan, T_new >= T_scan even with free construction. The raw observed ceiling is T_reference/T_scan. The optimistic diagnostic subtracts the entire positive paired profile-minus-rebound total difference plus the maximum of 4096 observed clock pairs from scan_ns, flooring at zero. A nonpositive adjusted scan gives null, not a finite bound. These are conditional timing diagnostics, not universal runtime lower bounds or calibrated operation counts.
guards: Every result must complete and verify. Models, semantic work and traces must match the original retained policy. For a representativeness claim, paired 95% intervals for rebound/original and profile/rebound totals must both fit inside [0.8,1.25]. A group outside this range or containing null ceilings is inconclusive.
decision: On n16/n20/n24 discovery groups only, a guarded optimistic-ceiling 95% upper bound below 2.0 rules out a constructor-only dramatic claim for that measured group under the unchanged-scan assumption. At least one such failure blocks a universal constructor-only claim on this discovery grid. A ceiling above 2 is only an opportunity, never a measured gain. No holdout or cryptanalytic promotion is allowed.
